outcome.Summary: Extended the config package: added `Timeout time.Duration` (env APP_TIMEOUT via time.ParseDuration, default 30s in Defaults) and `Tags []string` (env APP_TAGS, comma-split, trimmed, empty items dropped). Load now collects every invalid env value into errors joined with errors.Join, listing each offending variable name, and returns the zero Config on error; existing field behavior is unchanged. Added Merge(base, override Config) that replaces each non-zero override field, treats a non-nil override Tags slice (even empty) as a replacement, and never mutates the arguments' slices. Added tests covering new-field defaults, parsing, multi-error collection, and all Merge cases; `go test ./...`, `go vet` and `gofmt -l` all pass.
